application.name: Eldritch Companion EN RU BG
application.summary: Encounter card decks for Eldritch Horror in English, Russian and Bulgarian
application.desc:
Leave the card decks in the box. Eldritch Companion deals the encounter, location and expedition cards of the Eldritch Horror board game on your phone or tablet.
THREE LANGUAGES, SWITCHED MID-GAME • English, Russian and Bulgarian in one app. • Tap EN / RU / BG at any time. The current card and every deck change language in place. Discard piles and draw order stay the same. • Terms toggle: show game terms (LORE, WILL, card types, conditions) in your language or in English, to match the edition on your table. • Glossary panel: a tap explains every bracket token on the current card.
ALL THE DECKS • Americas, Europe, Asia/Australia, General, Gate, Expedition, Research, Mystic Ruins, Dream-Quest, Disaster, Devastation, and the expansion decks. • Antarctica, Egypt, Dreamlands and more: tick your expansions on Setup, or tap "All". • Expedition Deck screen: set the next expedition, remove a location's cards, or return them. • Discard pile screen: review and remove the cards of this game.
MADE FOR THE TABLE • Dark night-sky design that is easy on the eyes in a dim room. • Large card screen on parchment, with the three stations of each region card. • Tablet layouts for portrait and landscape. • Your game is saved on the device. Continue where you stopped.
PRIVATE • No ads. No account. No internet permission. The app collects no data.
This is an unofficial fan app. It is not made, approved or supported by Fantasy Flight Games. Eldritch Horror is a trademark of Fantasy Flight Games. You need the physical board game to play.
